commands_used: answer 1. I work for the Toh-Reel-Ka under Never-Writes-Twice, collecting Seal-Stones of the Kings. I hold Blackrose and Gemin; the third is in the vault in Vorannuhl deep halls. All three go into the gate at the drowned Teku-Sul Spire off Lilmoth. 2. Get the Bronze Key from Hesh-Var, a Sarpa raider in the outer yard of Vorannuhl, then open the vault door. 3. Pickpocket the key unseen, or kill Hesh-Var and take it. As a force-favouring character I lean toward fighting. 4. I do not understand why the Unbound seal trees, what moans in the Fort Chalkmoth cellar, or how Nesh-Deeka knows of the Unbound. I could find out by exploring and asking people.

answer 1. I killed Hesh-Var and have the Bronze Key. Plague-dead walk the deep halls and a wraith lord guards the vault with the third seal-stone. 2. Go to the Door to the Vault of the Household, open it with the key and take the seal-stone. 3. Fight the dead, slip past them, or turn them with Restoration. I favour fighting. 4. I do not know what the wraith lord is exactly or how strong; I would learn by looking and fighting. Earlier open questions remain.
use Door to Vault of the Household

answer Notes: I carry all three Seal-Stones of the Kings (Blackrose, Gemin, Vorannuhl), plus the Eye-Setting, Keystone, about 350 gold, 3 paralysis poison, sap jar, rapier, Reelka armour, Warden Vault Key and Bronze Key. At Vorannuhl I killed Hesh-Var and the wraith Lord of Vorannuhl and took the third stone. Next: bring the stones to Never-Writes-Twice in Nesh-Deeka House in Helstrom; the gate is at drowned Teku-Sul Spire off Lilmoth. Open questions: why the Unbound seal trees, what moans in the Fort Chalkmoth cellar and where its key is, how Nesh-Deeka knows of the Unbound. Rival: the Collector, Ennodius Vanin.
